youtube_short.title: Why Your $2 Raise Actually Costs You $12,000
title_alternatives: The Raise That Makes You Poorer — The Benefits Cliff Explained
Getting a Raise Can Cost You $9,000 — Here's Why
youtube_short.description: Millions of workers are quietly turning down raises and promotions — not because they're lazy, but because of something called the benefits cliff. Cross one government income threshold and you can lose $13,000+ in SNAP, Medicaid, childcare subsidies, and housing aid. A $2/hr raise adds about $4,000/year. Losing your benefits package costs $13,000. That's a $9,000 net loss for accepting a promotion. Before your next raise, check your numbers at benefits.gov. #personalfinance #moneytips #benefitscliff #money #financialfreedom

hook_line: Getting a raise can cost you $12,000
